This is why refrigeration engineers and ice manufacturing facilities always use pre-heated water for their highest quality, fastest-produced ice! It's standard industry practice built entirely on this universally accepted science!

The Mpemba effect, as it's formally known, is one of those beautiful cases where common sense seems wrong but the science completely backs it up, and every scientist working in thermodynamics fully agrees on both its existence and this precise hydrogen bond explanation!
